role: Live control panel — floating UI overlay, no backend server of its own. All real actions are DOM/browser-side calls into window.BrainOS, described here so co-pilot or any other real caller can discover and drive it without reading nexus/ui/brainos/brainos.js directly.
_honest_scope: James: 'Interaction contract for the ui to float... that way co-pilot can interact with it.' This is a client-side widget, not an HTTP service — there is no port, no /health. 'routes' below are real JS calls against window.BrainOS (nexus/ui/brainos/brainos.js), not HTTP endpoints. If BrainOS ever gains its own real backend aggregator, THAT gets its own interaction-contract.json in the established server shape (see guardian/interaction-contract.json) — this file should not be stretched to pretend that already exists.

real_data_sources.confirmed: guardian/server.js — SISOStream.emit unconditionally calls cockpitBroadcast() for every real bus event; first event on connect is {type:'connected'}

guardian/lib/command-index-extract.js — real source-extraction from guardian/server.js's own literal dispatch code, 50 real commands + 14 named unresolved sub-routers, built 2026-09-03 (docs/command-index-per-system.spec phase 3)
clear-glass/src/ipc/bridge.js's _buildCommandIndex() — real, live Express router introspection, not a static file
ollama/lib/command-index.js — real aggregation of all 6 route modules' self-declared commands, 17 real commands, built 2026-09-03 (docs/command-index-per-system.spec phase 2)
bridge/lib/command-index-extract.js — real source-extraction, 17 real commands + 1 named unresolved sub-router (/cfr/*), built 2026-09-03 (docs/command-index-per-system.spec phase 4)

routes.returns: the real, mounted panel DOM element
routes.description: Idempotent — calling mount() while already mounted returns the existing real panel, does not create a second one. If nexus/ui/brainos/brainos-canvas.js was loaded first, this also mounts the real node canvas inside the panel and feeds it every real SSE event from the SAME connection (no second connection opened).
Closes the real EventSource, unmounts the real canvas if present, removes the real panel from the DOM, resets internal state to its real initial shape.

returns.connected: boolean — real SSE connection state, not assumed true
returns.eventCount: number — real events received this session
returns.position: {top, left} real CSS pixel strings, or null if unmounted

routes.description: The one real read path co-pilot or any other caller should use to check panel state — never reach into the DOM or internal _state directly, both are unstable across versions.

Real node graph — one node per real system (orchestrator.config.json's own real ports list, 14 systems) plus one per real agent/provider (guardian/lib/provider-routing.js's own real KNOWN_PROVIDERS). Normally called by BrainOS.mount() automatically, exposed directly for a caller that wants the canvas without the rest of the panel chrome.
Triggers one real, bounded CSS pulse animation on the named node. A no-op (never throws, never fabricates) for a node id that doesn't exist.

Real event router — call with a real event object (the same shape received from guardian's /events SSE) to pulse the matching real node(s). guardian's own node pulses on every call (every event on this stream is guardian's own); an event.provider field additionally pulses that agent's node.
The real, current list of node ids this canvas actually renders — the one real source of truth for 'which nodes exist,' never hardcoded elsewhere.

known_gaps_this_first_slice_does_not_clo: topology lines between nodes are real, named, static structural relationships (each with a real source citation, checked in a real <title> tooltip) — NOT a live call trace; docs/brainos-live-control-panel.spec's own canvas_mechanics section already flagged that a live per-call edge-glow mechanism doesn't exist anywhere in this codebase yet

only guardian's own node and provider-tagged agent nodes get a real, confirmed live PULSE — the other 13 real NEXUS systems' command indexes are now real and fetched (see real_data_sources above), but that is static route metadata, not a live event feed; no confirmed live heartbeat source reaches them today. Wiring a real cross-system event relay is separate, not-yet-scoped future work
no WebGL canvas yet — this slice is real SVG, not ui/eravos/runtime/alk-gl.js's particle field; reusing that engine is real future work, not attempted here

no cfr.entropy/coherence/friction field mapping wired yet (docs/brainos-live-control-panel.spec's canvas_mechanics section) — GET /cfr/stream was confirmed live in an earlier session but this slice does not yet subscribe to it
co-pilot does not yet call any of the routes above — this contract makes that possible, it does not itself wire copilot/server.js to call it

bridge/server.js and guardian.spec/bridge.spec still carry their own separate, hand-maintained routes: lists alongside the new real, live-extracted /commands endpoints — found and measured as real, stale drift while building phases 3-4 (guardian: 4 declared vs 50 real; bridge: 15 declared vs 17 real), not reconciled by this pass
